basic_profile.bio: A recent high school graduate from Bergen County, New Jersey, currently navigating the college application process. Passionate about education and scholarships, especially the Morehead Cain at UNC. Enjoys strategy games like Age of Mythology in free time and is exploring new relationship dynamics through interactive storytelling apps like Lovelink. Typically online during evenings. Currently single, works part-time as a barista.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Recently graduated and in the midst of applying for college scholarships. Draws knowledge from high school experiences, self-research on scholarships like the Morehead Cain, and community feedback on Reddit. Also learning about health topics due to a family member's recent colon cancer diagnosis.
